{{Quote|They cut him to pieces, left him on the counter in his tapcafe. You, uh&hellip; want me to notify his wife?|Moro|<ref name="Local Trouble">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Local Trouble|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''wife''' of [[Ben Kahob]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Their husband owned a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Coronas]] gang.
